How SpotDraft made contract chaos a thing of the past for IPSY’s small but mighty legal team
When you’re growing fast, contracts can pile up even faster. That’s the challenge IPSY’s legal team faced as the beauty subscription brand scaled.“Before SpotDraft, we were completely reactive. We just handled whatever came in.”
‍
Anna Claveria Brannan
Deputy General Counsel at IPSY
Anna oversees compliance, IP, and legal operations at IPSY. As the company grew, so did the number and complexity of contracts: NDAs, vendor agreements, creator partnerships. The legal team quickly realized their first CLM solution wasn’t cutting it.
‍
Watch what our partners at IPSY have to say:
‍
Why IPSY chose SpotDraft
After trying out a different CLM and finding it too limiting, IPSY went back to the drawing board. That’s when they discovered SpotDraft.“SpotDraft had everything we needed, from managing workflows to storing contracts to getting signatures done.”
The team was especially impressed by SpotDraft’s intuitive experience. Implementation was quick, just a couple of meetings, and the transition from Google Docs was seamless.
‍
Empowering business teams and saving legal time
One of the biggest wins? IPSY’s business teams can now handle smaller agreements themselves, freeing legal to focus on more complex work.“SpotDraft has helped us be more efficient. It’s effortless.”
Collaboration is smoother too. Legal can loop in stakeholders for approvals and track who’s reviewed a document, all in one place.
‍
A CLM that evolves with you
SpotDraft didn’t just meet IPSY’s needs, it kept improving. Midway through their journey, SpotDraft introduced built-in e-signature capabilities, letting the team work end-to-end in one tool.“We’re a small team doing big things. SpotDraft helps us keep up without getting overwhelmed”
‍
Why IPSY recommends SpotDraft
Easy implementation and user-friendly workflows
Frees up legal bandwidth by empowering business users
Fast, responsive support team
A true partner that scales with you“We’ve used SpotDraft for a couple of years. The customer support still blows us away. They respond within minutes.”
